mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(wp.weekly_points, 0) DESC) AS ranking, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_img, ul.level, COALESCE(wp.weekly_points, 0) AS weekly_points FROM users u JOIN user_level ul ON u.user_id = ul.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = TRUE THEN 10 ELSE 2 END) AS weekly_points FROM quiz_result WHERE YEARWEEK(solved_at, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) GROUP BY user_id ) wp ON u.user_id = wp.user_id WHERE COALESCE(wp.weekly_points, 0) > 0 ORDER BY weekly_points DESC LIMIT 20
